text:
evan: Quick sync — we need a migration/deprecation plan for prompt-style completions -> messages API. Must preserve system role semantics, function calling, and structured output. Any major blockers?

lia: +1. Enterprise customers care about deterministic system role behavior and per-message metadata (origin, template id) for audit logs.

sara: Also lots of customers use prompt templating server-side. Migration should accept a single `prompt` payload and optionally synthesize messages server-side as a compatibility path.

omar: Suggest an opt-in compatibility flag, e.g. `compatibility_mode: \"prompt\"` that accepts legacy prompt and converts to messages internally. Emit warnings in response headers and SDKs.

priya: Function-calling is tricky — prompts often embed tool instructions. We should provide a `function_hints` mapping so conversion can wire prompt-language to function signatures.

lia: Example compat payload to illustrate: 
```json
{
  \"compatibility_mode\": \"prompt\",
  \"prompt\": \"System: You are a concise assistant.\\nUser: Summarize the doc.\",
  \"tools\": [\"search\", \"code_exec\"]
}
```

sara: For structured output, expose a `schema` field in both modes. If user passes `schema` with prompt, treat it like a system-level contract and validate/parse output accordingly.

omar: Proposed GA criteria: migrated 3 top enterprise customers with zero critical regressions, SDK helpers for conversion available, docs + deprecation notice posted (>=90 days).

ev an: (typo) — OK. Action items: @lia draft migration API (compat flag + logging headers + header that returns conversion map), @sara implement SDK helpers (py/js), @omar own deprecation timeline + comms, @priya prototype `function_hints` mapping. :thumbsup: 

product-bot: New doc created: /docs/migration-guide/messages-from-prompt (auto)

sara: Telemetry note — record original submission shape (`prompt` vs `messages`) and conversion diffs for 30d so we catch edge cases early.

lia: Agreed. I'll also loop in Legal about audit retention for system-role content and templated prompts.

ev an: Can we have a PoC by next week? @sara @omar

omar: Yes — small shim + unit tests by Wed.

priya: I'll pair with @sara on function examples and edge-case prompts.

sara: I'll open a tracking issue with the payload examples + tests.

evan: Great. We'll reconvene after the PoC. Thanks all!
